messages:
katie (docs): Hey team — PR ready for a small docs add: FAQ + examples for Dedicated autoscale policies w/ isolation/preemption notes. Short TL;DR in the top of the PR. Can folks sanity-check wording and the YAML snippet?

sam (eng): Thanks! will take a look in ~30m. Quick note: current runtime will evict if reserved_capacity==0 and tenant_priority is low; do we want that spelled out?

oliver (infra): yes please. include the edge-case where node-level maintenance triggers eviction even if autoscale is healthy. It caught us in staging last week.

ryan (pm): also add one sentence on SLA impact: dedicated tenants on reserved plans keep their latency SLA but may lose throughput during preemption — wording needs to be clear.

deploy-bot: PR opened — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842

katie (docs): pushing a change now: added `eviction-behavior` FAQ and a brief example snippet. LMK if the YAML looks correct.

sam (eng): snippet looks fine, except suggest adding `grace_period: 120s` to the scaleDown policy so retries can finish. example:
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 16
  scaleDown:
    policy: cpu
    threshold: 40
    grace_period: 120s
```

oliver (infra): also call out that `isolation.decorator: true` will allocate tenant to an isolated pool and bypass eviction, but make it explicit that reserved capacity is still charged.

katie (docs): good catches — updated the YAML and added a line about reserved billing. Also rephrased SLA bit to: "Latency SLA maintained for reserved capacity; reduced throughput may occur during eviction events."

ryan (pm): wording looks much better. can we include a short example sentence about migration: "If you're migrating from shared to dedicated, pre-warm a reserved pool to avoid cold-start evictions." simple instruction for runbooks.

katie (docs): added migration note; added links to runbook + terraform snippet. requesting review from eng for final sign-off.

sam (eng): approved. small nit: change `cpu` to `utilization` in the YAML to match runtime naming. otherwise :+1:

katie (docs): done. thanks everyone — will merge after CI passes and then backfill the handbook link. :tada:
